name: wos-task
description: Universal task intake and concise agenda delivery for approved work sources, with no database or automatic hooks.

interface.shortDescription: v1.1 · Universal intake with a concise agenda brief
interface.longDescription: Workflow OS Task pulls action items, deliverables, and follow-ups from chat, meetings, documents, Jira, and available approved connectors. It delivers a clear in-chat agenda brief by default, with full detail available on request and explicit Jira-ready handoffs when needed.
defaultPrompt: Pull action items from my meeting notes and add them to my agenda.
Help me prioritize my task agenda.
